description: This file implements a vhost-user input backend in Rust, defining the VhostUserInput struct and its associated methods for handling virtio queues, configuration, and events in a virtualized environment.
external_methods: std::io::{stdout, Error as IoError, ErrorKind as IoErrorKind, Read, Result as IoResult, Write}

classes.name: VhostUserInput
classes.description: A struct representing the vhost-user input backend, parameterized over a reader type R, managing virtio queues, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new VhostUserInput instance with specified device configuration and reader.

methods.name: send_pending_events
methods.description: Sends pending input events to the guest via the virtio queue, handling buffer management and notifications.

methods.name: read_input_events
methods.description: Reads input events into the buffer, preparing them for transmission.

methods.name: write_status_updates
methods.description: Writes status updates back to the guest via the virtio queue.

methods.name: register_handlers
methods.description: Registers epoll handlers for stdin events.
